stages.name: draft
stages.command: python3 transform_stub.py draft --main inputs/main.md --out output2/draft.md --meta work2/draft_meta.json

stages.name: finalize
stages.command: python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py update --result output2/result.json --field draft_path --value output2/draft.md && python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py update --result output2/result.json --field word_count --value-json "$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('work2/draft_meta.json'))['draft_chars'])")" && python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py update --result output2/result.json --field limitations --value-json "[]" && python3 ../scripts/result_guard.py finalize --result output2/result.json --outdir output2 --case case_fixed.json
